_note: COUPLING-1 occurrence ratchet. The count is the catalog-wide sum, over every skill SKILL.md, of the distinct Claude-Code-only surfaces it depends on (the CLAUDE_COUPLING set in tools/export-agents-skills.py: MCP server, SessionStart hook / plugin data, polymath-flows runner, hook script path). A skill that references a surface a generic agentskills.io host does not provide cannot fully run when exported. This ceiling freezes that portability cost: it may only ratchet DOWN. A change that adds coupling must either make the skill portable or consciously raise this number (a reviewed decision), so coupling never grows silently. Per-occurrence enumeration (which skill, which line) is COUPLING-2, deferred until the first external adopter or a canary failure. Lower the ceiling whenever the live count drops. Raised 44 → 63 (2026-10, reviewed): the MCP reuse layer added an MCP-binding preamble to 15 connector skills (references the mcpResolution snapshot — the preamble is what makes those skills REUSE host-registered MCP servers on other hosts instead of assuming a Claude Code plugin install) and the new polymath-core:mcp-bridge skill (references the mcp-registry scanner + project-context snapshot). Raised 63 → 66 (2026-10, reviewed): the adversarial skill-quality pass made polymath-core:glossary the single source of truth for MCP/capability/routing vocabulary (it now defines MCP server, mcpResolution, route-signals, provider identity, portability) and polymath-core:conventions document component choice + hook-path/quoting conventions — both legitimately reference Claude-coupled surfaces because describing the coupling IS their job.
